parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: PlaybookUuid
parameters.description:
The playbook UUID.

>  You can call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~)operation to query the playbook UUID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sophonsoar describe-node-param-tags --playbook-uuid ac343acc-1a61-4084-9a1c-xxxxxxx --node-name python3_2 --lang zh --api-version 2022-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sophonsoar DescribeNodeParamTags --region cn-hangzhou --PlaybookUuid 'ac343acc-1a61-4084-9a1c-xxxxxxx' --NodeName python3_2 --Lang zh
